nodes.label: D-264: SETUP-SPIKE-000 continues for SV-002; V1-SM05 BLOCKED
nodes.description: Judge ruling 2026-09-25. Supersedes D-258 item 2 and item 4's does-not-reopen clause, and D-257 item 3: setup continues as the container for validation attempt SV-002; S2-S4 stay terminally deferred with no DoD credit; the loader spike is commissioned as SV2-U02 and B-130 returns to Open. V1-SM05 packet status BLOCKED (not a lane state). SV-001 tags the completed pre-selection handoff validation as the success-drift baseline. Adds the closure transfer invariant and the reusable dor-dod-validation/v1 template.

nodes.label: Template dor-dod-validation/v1
nodes.description: Reusable, result-free DoR/DoD validation template (D-264). Six-scope coverage chain (Project, Product, execution scope, backlog refinement, historical dialogue and tooling, attempt lineage), closure transfer invariant, parent/child run rule, drift ledger and success-drift comparison. Immutable once used; attempts pin its SHA-256; a change creates v2. Lives outside docs/v1 because it serves every version.

nodes.label: Attempt SV-001: pre-selection handoff validation (historical)
nodes.description: Retrospective wrapper (D-264) over the completed V1-SM05 DOR-R1 to DOR-R7 pre-selection handoff validation and its Jev receipt. Complete at the time and the success-drift baseline; not a feature DoR/DoD run; its rows are never re-checked or copied. Later-observed limitation: setup gaps were not transferred into it.

nodes.label: Attempt SV-002: setup validation
nodes.description: First run of dor-dod-validation/v1 (D-264), DoR open. Units SV2-U01 governance application, SV2-U02 loader characterization (Lane B parent run tracker, Lane C child run tracker), SV2-U03 code navigation, SV2-U04 B-071/B-095/B-104 dependency map. Blocks V1-SM05 selection until accepted and the Judge lifts the block.

nodes.label: SV2-U03 code-navigation evaluation (ripwire candidate)
nodes.description: Read-only Lane A evaluation (D-264): ripwire cannot parse SQL, where most V1-SM05 logic lives; its Windows build is a preview; it is pre-1.0. Recommends the existing rg/tsc/test path and no ripwire for V1-SM05, pending Lane B consumer evidence and the Judge's outcome.
